title: Selected term of a DNF formula
statement: Let $n$ be a natural number, let $\\varphi$ be a disjunction of conjunctions of literals, and let $x\\in\\{\\pm1\\}^n$. If $\\varphi(x)=-1$, select a term of $\\varphi$ that evaluates to $-1$ at $x$; if $\\varphi(x)\\ne-1$, select the empty term.
